proposal_metadata.description: Governed module size policy reducing artificial fragmentation and cosmetic line packing while preserving architectural quality and complexity limits.

up_to_400.description: No size warning; all independent architectural checks (complexity, layer dependencies, cycles, credential, storage) still apply.

401_to_650_ordinary.description: Nonblocking size warning when cognitive complexity (<= 15) and dependency checks pass. Review cohesion within normal PR; zero forced splitting or operator interruption.

651_to_800_declarative.description: Nonblocking size warning only for explicit declarative tables or models validated against AST executable structure. Naming a file models or placing under dual_pipeline cannot qualify it. Ordinary implementation in this range blocks.

above_warning_range.description: Requires a scoped, documented size exception through the existing governed review mechanism (file_budget_exclusions.json) with active attestations and expiration date, or a concern-based refactor. No unreviewed blanket higher limit.

legacy_baselines.description: Preserve baseline inventory and approved exceptions. Unchanged or documentation/formatting-only executable structure does not trigger a forced size repair. Functional growth beyond registered allowance requires an explicit exception or scoped refactor; no silent baseline increase.

structural_violation_invariance.description: Preserve applicable blocking complexity, import-direction (L0-L6), cycle, credential, and storage checks. A size exception cannot waive these independent checks.

parsing_and_policy_evidence_error.condition: Missing, malformed, expired, or mismatched policy evidence or unparseable source
parsing_and_policy_evidence_error.description: Report a policy/configuration error; never silently exempt the file or report a successful evaluation.

BLOCK.range: Structural or complexity violation at any line count

complexity_reconciliation.reconciliation_rationale: Reconcile stale rule complexity value of 10 with registry 15 without silently weakening stricter domain control.
